items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: And, uh, who else was with you and Herb Moran on that boat? ... Me, Moran, and then the two of the other.

ctx.x: And, uh, who else was with you and Herb Moran on that boat?
Me, Moran, and then the two of the other. Tom, Tom, Tom, uh, Tom, his name was Tom. Ha! I know.
